name: Deep Dive
description: Many comparisons within one specific theme/character/series: narrow seed tag, large pool, tight similarity distance.

name: Wide Sweep
description: General-purpose ranking session across the whole library: broad/no seed tag, random pool strategy, loose similarity distance.

name: Cleanup Pass
description: Burns down the 'still uncertain' backlog: seeded from currently high-sigma (least-confident) items, paired via Confidence Duel to converge fastest.
